what_failed.description: The site or server could not be reached at all, for example a DNS error, a timeout or a 5xx server error.
The service refused the agent: an access-denied page, a 403 or 429 error, a bot wall or a challenge page.
The site's robots.txt asks automated agents not to fetch this page.
A CAPTCHA or 'are you human?' check stopped the agent.
Logging in or authenticating failed, for example a login loop, a new login step or rejected credentials.
An API the agent used returned an error or an unexpected response.
An MCP server failed to connect, initialise, list its tools or run a tool.
A skill could not be installed, or it ran but errored or produced a wrong result.
A payment or checkout step failed or was blocked.
One particular page or step failed while the rest of the service seemed to work.
